name: ihp_160ghz_hbt
description: IHP 160 GHz mm-wave SiGe-HBT LNA (TO_Apr2025, 160GHz_LNA/). Four cascaded common-emitter npn13G2 HBT gain stages (npn13G5..npn13G8) with explicit lumped bias capacitors/resistors, but every signal-path passive -- input/inter-stage/output matching lines, the emitter-degeneration networks, and the bias chokes -- is realised as an electromagnetically-modelled two-port referenced by an S-parameter (.s2p) file (Choke.s2p, Dgen*.s2p, 1st_TL..4th_TL.s2p). STRETCH / needs-work candidate.

source.project: IHP-GmbH open-source SG13G2 tapeout, April 2025 campaign, 160GHz_LNA
source.license: Apache-2.0 (IHP-GmbH TO_* campaign family, same as ihp-gps-lna-nmos/npn and ihp-lna-2p45g)
source.format_as_retrieved: QUCS-S schematic (.sch) plus an S-parameter table (160GHz_LNA_pi_model.dat.ngspice) and a pi-model schematic. README: 146-173 GHz band, NF 5.77 dB @160 GHz, peak gain 12.5 dB, IP1dB -11.4 dBm.

conversion.attempted: QUCS-S -> AnalogGenie device-level topology (topology + device list).
active_devices_read: npn13G5, npn13G6, npn13G7, npn13G8 -- four npn13G2 HBTs, one per common-emitter stage
lumped_passives_read: cap_rfcmim / cap_cmim bias and RF-coupling capacitors (explicit numeric values in the schematic)
rsil / rhigh bias resistors (explicit numeric widths)
em_only_passives_that_block_conversion: Choke.s2p (x4)   -- per-stage bias chokes, EM two-ports, no lumped value
Dgen*.s2p / Dgen_final_stage.s2p -- emitter-degeneration networks, EM two-ports
1st_TL.s2p, 2nd_TL.s2p, 3rd_TL.s2p, 4th_TL.s2p -- inter-stage matching transmission lines, EM two-ports

quarantine_reason: BLOCKED (stretch candidate, needs-work). The topology's defining passives -- ALL matching, all inter-stage transmission lines, the bias chokes, and the emitter-degeneration networks -- exist only as electromagnetically-modelled S-parameter two-ports (.s2p) whose lumped-equivalent values are NOT present in the schematic (they live in the .s2p tables as frequency-sampled S-data). AnalogGenie's device vocabulary has no S-parameter/two-port token; converting would require replacing every .s2p block with a lumped R/L/C nominal value that the source does not provide. Per the ingestion rules that value may not be invented, so a faithful topology-plus-devices conversion is not achievable here. The four HBT stages and the explicit lumped bias caps/resistors ARE transcribable, but a netlist with the entire signal path (input match, 4x inter-stage TLs, output match, degeneration, chokes) omitted or guessed would not represent this circuit. Recorded as BLOCKED rather than forced. Revisit path: extract lumped-equivalent L/C from each .s2p at the 160 GHz band centre via a fitting step -- deferred, requires tooling not in this task and would itself introduce fitted (not source) values that must be flagged.
notes: No generated/ token sequence is staged for this id: with the signal-path passives unresolved there is no honest topology to augment. The provenance is staged so the block reason and the full device inventory are on record for a future EM-de-embedding pass. Independent of, and unrelated to, the Kanchetla et al. TMTT 2022 paper this pipeline is blind-reproducing: this is a 146-173 GHz mm-wave HBT amplifier, a different band, process option, and application from the excluded GNSS narrowband CMOS design; the source contains no mention of Kanchetla, NavIC, or BeiDou.
